name: duckling_tuft_crest
rationale: Plan: a friendly, compact 'duckling tuft' crest echoing Microduck's yellow identity. A 16x16x2.5 mm elliptical adhesive base sits at the head-top tangent; on it, one backward-leaning rounded ellipsoid tuft (18 mm long, 11 mm tall, tilted -25 deg) forms a soft pompadour silhouette, flanked by two small bilateral ellipsoid bumps for a cute feather-bud look. Nothing exceeds the 35 mm zone height, all parts are rounded with no sharp edges, and the camera face is untouched. Symmetry bilateral so the Y>=0 bump fuses with its mirror. PLA in warm duck-yellow. Mounting retention, curvature fit and print behavior remain open per the unverified interface.
